title: Concept: pubspec without an SDK constraint
description: pubspec.yaml declares a pubspec that declares no Dart SDK range, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The resolver accepts the package on any SDK, so a language change or a removed API surfaces at build time instead of resolution time.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pubspec.yaml (pub).
risk: The resolver accepts the package on any SDK, so a language change or a removed API surfaces at build time instead of resolution time.
